FAQ

Pricing questions

Why don't you list prices?

Every business needs something different, so we quote each one in writing. Quotes are itemised, valid for 30 days and easy to change.

Which currency are quotes in?

AUD for Australian clients and USD for international clients.

Is ad spend included?

No. Third-party ad spend is shown separately so you always know what goes to Google or Meta.

How is custom software priced?

Custom software is quoted per project after a free consultation, with no per-user monthly licence fees.

Can we switch plans later?

Yes. You can move up or down as your needs change. We'll update your quote.

Is there a setup fee?

Any setup work is itemised in your written quote, so there are no surprises.

Do you require long contracts?

Terms are set out clearly in your quote before you start.

Can we combine a plan with custom software?

Yes. Many clients run marketing plans alongside a custom system, with one account manager for both.
